title: Re-align stale @objectstack/objectql tests with current overlay registry & sys_metadata schema
body:
`@objectstack/objectql#test` (the only failing CI job) blew up the first time the `Test Core` paths filter re-engaged after the project-mode/overlay refactor — `f0c87d977` touched `packages/**` LICENSE files and surfaced ~21 stale fixtures (4 real failures once workspace deps are built).

### Root cause

- `ba252da0b` (project mode, metadata forms, org overlays) flipped `allowOrgOverride: false → true` in `DEFAULT_METADATA_TYPE_REGISTRY` for `object`, `field`, `action`, `flow`, `workflow`, `approval`, `agent`. Whitelist tests still expected those types to be rejected.
- `482eb67cc` + `feat(metadata): durable sys_metadata_history writes` reshaped `sys_metadata` rows (added `checksum`/`created_at`/`updated_at`, dropped `scope`), split history into a dedicated `sys_metadata_history` table, added `parentVersion` optimistic-concurrency, and stopped wrapping DB errors with `"Failed to persist customization overlay…"`. Persistence assertions never followed.

### Changes — test files only, no production code touched

- **`overlay-precedence.test.ts`** — denied list rebuilt around the types that are still `allowOrgOverride: false` (`trigger`, `validation`, `hook`, `datasource`, `router`, `function`, `service`); the "registry-as-source-of-truth" invariant now pins the current allowed/denied split and its plural-form coverage uses a denied type with a real `SINGULAR_TO_PLURAL` entry. Header docstring rewritten so the architectural intent stays accurate.
- **`protocol-meta.test.ts`** — insert/update expectations match the new row shape; update-path tests now pass the correct `parentVersion` derived from the mocked existing row's checksum; fail-fast tests assert raw DB error propagation (`/Connection refused/`, `/Table not found/`) instead of the removed wrapper.
- **`protocol-meta-types-rich.test.ts`** — switched the deny + `OBJECTSTACK_METADATA_WRITABLE` env-elevation cases to `function`/`trigger` (still non-overridable), and registered both in `beforeEach` so `getMetaTypes()` (which iterates `engine.registry.getRegisteredTypes()`) actually surfaces them.
- **`sys-metadata-repository.test.ts`** — `put refuses non-allowOrgOverride types` cases switched from `object`/`flow` to `trigger`/`function`.

### Result

`pnpm turbo run test --filter @objectstack/objectql` → **23 files, 371/371 passing**. `CHANGELOG.md` updated.
